newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Siddons Ramset divests gas hot water unit.
newsitem.headline: Siddons Ramset divests gas hot water unit.

text.p: Hardware and tools manufacturer Siddons Ramset Ltd said on Monday its had sold its Siddons Raypak gas hot water division to Raypak Australia, whose parent operates a similar business in North America.
Siddons said the unit represented less than three percent of its revenue, while its disposal would be profit neutral.
Siddons managing director Roger Flynn said while the business had improved recent performance, its natural owner was by a company with a larger presence in hot water heating.
Siddons shares closed a cent lower at A$7.44.
